senses.gloss: f. (ἀπραγία, ἀπραξία) inactivity, cessation of labor, holiday. Pesik. Sh’mini, p. 195ᵃ (v. Buber note 66 to p. 193ᵃ) if both of us open (sales) at the same time הרי אנו עושין אפרגיא במדינה (Ar. Var. אפרגיזא, אפרגינה, read אפרגזיא) we shall create a cessation of labor in the district (as all the laboring people will run to the market town on one and the same day; Yalk. Num. 782 זול from misunderstanding); Cant. R. to VII, 2 אפרגייס (read אפרגייא or אפרגסייא).
units: Pesik. R. s. 41 R. Yonathan … had goods with him והייתה אפרגיס (corr. acc.) and there was inactivity and dull business in consequence thereof [for which Yalk. Ps. 758 ולא היה יכול למוכרה—prob. to be read אַפְּרַטוֹס ἄπρατος unsaleable].
